# Gone Fission: Fish Chowder

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jun 1, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_270a39bbc7ae49339fb1ac0d3c26b64a~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

__Fish Chowder__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_26ef5421ea4440fdb1a0a0350a93629d~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

- 25% Slowed Hunger for 30 minutes
- This buff works for Carnivore.
- Mutations and SIN do not affect duration or buff

**Buff Duration:**

- 30 minutes

**Radiation:**

- 2 Rads

**Ingredients**

- Fishing Bits x5
- Wood x3
- Boiled Water x1
- Salt x1
- Pepper x1
- Cream x1

**Weight**

- 1 Pound

**Spoil Rate**

- Base: 4 Hours
- 30% Reduced Spoil Rate: 5.2 hours
- 50% Reduced Spoil Rate: 6 hours
- 60% Reduced Spoil Rate: 6.4 hours
- 90% Reduced Spoil Rate: 7.6 Hours

**Crafted at**

- Cooking Station > All Food
- Cooking Station > Meat
- Cooking Station > Prepared

**Perk Cards and Effects**

- Super Duper: Works when crafting.
- Stacking Effects: 
 - Stacks with other buffs that reduce or slow Hunger
- Persistence: This buff remains active even if you server-hop or leave the game.

**Obtained via**

- Plan: 
 - Has a 7.69% chance to drop from the Pip-Boy Daily "Big Fish in a Small Pond"
 - The plan is tradeable and continues dropping after being learnt.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
